# Security Checklist: Production Triage Outcome Routing

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009F security requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable for safe routing evidence, inert display, recommendation-only behavior, and secret-safe artifact handling.
**Created**: 2026-05-21
**Feature**: specs/009f-production-triage-routing/spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are safe evidence reference requirements defined for every route artifact family and every supported non-remediation disposition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK002 Are redaction and unsafe-content exclusions specified for rationale, next-action, closure rationale, blocking-question, and evidence-needed text fields before persistence and display? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK003 Are secret detector ownership boundaries clear between SPEC-009F payload validation and existing task artifact storage behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements explicit that raw artifact bodies, raw issue bodies, raw terminal logs, storage URIs, signed URLs, parser internals, actor identity, and PII-bearing key/value material must not be exposed through `triage_routing` API/UI output? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK005 Are no-external-mutation requirements complete across GitHub close, comment, label application, assignment, agent dispatch, spec worktree creation, automatic setup, and successor creation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-038]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Are bounded text normalization requirements quantified with concrete length, control-character, and newline limits for stored/displayed SPEC-009F strings? [Resolved, Spec §Security Normalization And Link Allowlist, Data Model §Lane Payload Envelope, Contract §Text Field Normalization Contract, Plan §Exact Likely Implementation Files]
  - Evidence: SPEC-009F now defines NFC/whitespace normalization, C0/C1 control rejection, field-specific character and newline limits, fail-closed over-limit behavior, and focused validator/UI test expectations.
- [x] CHK007 Are active-link allowlist requirements concrete about permitted protocols and destination families instead of relying on an undefined "strict validation" phrase? [Resolved, Spec §Security Normalization And Link Allowlist, Data Model §Lane Payload Envelope, Contract §Safe Evidence Reference Link Contract, Plan §Verification Plan]
  - Evidence: SPEC-009F now allows active links only for same-origin Mission Control task/artifact/activity references, GitHub issue/PR references in `racecraft-lab/mission-control`, and repo-local/static docs paths; unsafe schemes and non-allowlisted destinations render inert.
- [ ] CHK008 Are proposed GitHub label recommendations unambiguously metadata-only with normalized names, `recommend_add`, and `applied: false` semantics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK009 Are validation-failure and artifact-publish-failure evidence requirements clear that only sanitized field/path error reasons may persist? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK010 Are specialist recommendation requirements clear that no free-form issue/body/rationale keyword inference, raw agent config, or logs may determine owner selection? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031, Spec §FR-032]
